Scrambled egg on a square plate about 24 cm across. The egg pile covers roughly 9 cm by 7 cm, which is about 40 cm² of footprint. At a height of about 1.5 cm that gives a volume of roughly 40 cm³ after allowing for gaps. Scrambled egg weighs about 0.7 g/cm³ when loosely piled, so this comes to about 30–40 g. I estimate 35 g.
